title: GNSS availability and jamming/spoofing in stand-ins
description: Real satellite count/DOP from murmur-space; jammer/spoofer scenario events; ArduPilot-style EKF fallback to dead reckoning and per-firmware failsafes.

title: Console scale: virtualize the fleet list; draw 2D vehicles as a map layer, not DOM markers
description: ~27 DOM elements per vehicle (27k at 1,000 nodes). Virtualize the fleet list (group headers + windowing) and render 2D symbols as a MapLibre symbol layer or deck.gl IconLayer with picking, keeping the declutter and selection ring. Measure on a real GPU with ?perf at 1,000 and 3,000.

title: Console: error boundary and WebGL context-loss recovery
description: At 3,000 nodes the software WebGL context was lost (~90 s), then MapView threw (deck.gl overlay getProjection of null) and the whole page went blank. Add an error boundary around the map, handle webglcontextlost/restored (rebuild the overlay), and show a banner instead of a blank page.

title: Bridge: copter 'hold' uses LOITER, which lands the copter with no RC throttle
description: Found by the copter stand-in SITL comparison: SITL copters in LOITER with no RC descend, land and auto-disarm. Hold should keep position and altitude: BRAKE (or GUIDED with a position target at the current location). Affects real SITL copters (x10, fpv) today. Check other kinds' hold modes the same way.

Do after copter/VTOL and tracker branches merge (shared files).
notes: Also from copter/VTOL review: shared param table uses pre-4.8 names (WPNAV_*, RTL_ALT, ALT_HOLD_RTL) alongside 4.8 names (WP_SPD, RTL_ALT_M, RTL_ALTITUDE); version banner says 4.7.0-dev vs SITL 4.8.0-dev; consolidate behavior/auto.rs and behavior/apmission.rs (both emit AP_Mission texts).

Check CelesTrak's usage guidance and rate limits (earlier fetches by the space agent may have tripped it); fix politely (no User-Agent spoofing). Cache was loaded via murmur-space import as a workaround.

title: Space: link emulator satcom classes driven by real passes
description: linkemu satcom classes use murmur-space links()/link_at: outages, handovers, latency per class. Map platforms to SATCOM classes (proposed: buoy Iridium, USVs Starlink, RQ-4/MQ-9B WGS; commercial Ku GEO missing).

title: Space: console timeline, footprints, globe inset
description: Bridge /api/space/*; access-window timeline as main space view; footprints/swaths/link lines on the theater map; MapLibre globe inset with orbits.

description: Use murmur-space tasking_options; intent carries norad_id + collect_time; re-check at approval; log query, time_map, cache_meta for replay. See crates/murmur-space/README.md.

title: Space segment: taskable satellites as infrastructure (coverage, collection, SATCOM)
description: Satellites as taskable infrastructure, not flown nodes. The operator asks for a capability over an area and time window (imagery/SAR collection, SATCOM coverage or capacity, GNSS assurance); the system computes feasible passes from real orbits (SGP4 from public TLEs, CelesTrak) and sensor constraints (swath, off-nadir limits, day/night for EO, revisit), offers options with timing (collect -> downlink -> product latency), the human picks; it flows through the Phase C intent pipeline (new intent kinds e.g. collect, cover). Satellite SATCOM passes also drive the link emulator's satcom class and GNSS availability. UI: theater map shows footprints/swaths during passes and link lines; a linked globe view shows orbits; a timeline (access windows per satellite over the area) is the primary space view, because for satellites 'when' matters more than 'where'. Not modeled: satellite bus control, CCSDS, ground-station scheduling internals. Discussed with the user 2026-10-02.

title: SITL antenna tracker stalls ~45 deg short of targets east of it
description: Track task: tracker's own computed bearing is correct (NAV_CONTROLLER_OUTPUT nav_bearing=101 for a boat at true bearing 101.7) but ATTITUDE yaw creeps to ~45 deg and stalls (error ~56 deg). Same stall with YAW_RANGE 340 (sim mount is +/-170 per libraries/SITL/SIM_Tracker.h; did not verify the param took effect). Locking on works for targets in other directions (locked on AIR 01 at startup). Suspects: SERVO1 PWM range vs SIM_Tracker yaw_input scaling, or position-servo PID in AntennaTracker/servos.cpp update_yaw_position_servo. Check SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW and PARAM YAW_RANGE.
close_reason: Fixed in c0826e7 (+ ArduPilot patches; rebuild pending for 9bf limits)
